create_remote_device_from_string: create a _remote_device instance from a string like 'trainer0/cpu' or 'rank:0/cuda:0'
create_remote_device_from_torch_device: create a _remote_device instance from a torch.device object
test_remote_device_worker_name: test the worker_name() method of _remote_device to retrieve the remote worker name
test_remote_device_rank: test the rank() method of _remote_device to retrieve the process rank
test_remote_device_device: test the device() method of _remote_device to retrieve the local device on the remote worker
